explanation: The inverse transformation has Jacobian matrix \(\begin{pmatrix}y&x&0\\0&z&y\\z&0&x\end{pmatrix}\), with determinant \(2xyz\). Since \(uvw=(xy)(yz)(xz)=(xyz)^2\) and x,y,z are positive, \(xyz=\sqrt{uvw}\). Taking the reciprocal gives the Jacobian determinant of T as \(1/(2\sqrt{uvw})\).
